bk_01.subject: Eye-level wide view split by the water line of a brown river, the water line across the upper third. Above the water: a Filipino boy about eleven, small and wiry, sun-darkened brown skin, thick straight black hair cut blunt just above his eyebrows, bright quick dark eyes, bare-chested, a plain rust-red cloth loincloth wrapped at the waist, barefoot, no tattoos, no jewellery, kneeling at the edge of a wooden dock, leaning out, mouth wide open in a shout. Just below the water line, in murky green: a young man in a red headband sinking, his fist full of small gold ornaments raised toward the surface, and far below him a dark tall shape with long trailing moss-like hair and two coal-red eyes gripping his ankle and pulling him down. Bubbles rise. The boy's face and the gold fist in the upper half.
bk_01.setting: under the brown-green river water at the port of Butuan in 1011: murky water, drifting silt and bubbles, the broken wooden hull of a sunken plank boat on the muddy riverbed, planks pegged and lashed with black fibre; nothing modern
bk_01.light: murky green-brown underwater light, wavering sunbeams slanting down from the bright surface, rippling caustics, deep dark green below, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork
bk_01.note: Indio's face reads calm rather than panicked; the air above the dock is lit like the water

bk_42b.note: a medium close-up; the flame is beside his face rather than under it

bk_43.subject: Eye-level medium close-up at night of a young Filipino man about twenty, lean, warm brown skin, short tousled black hair in a small topknot, dark brown eyes, no headband, dark sunglasses pushed up on top of his head, wearing a brand-new shiny black short-sleeved shirt open at the collar, new dark jeans, a thick shiny gold chain around his neck, six thin straight indigo lines tattooed across his right forearm, a thin red thread with one small knot round his left wrist, seen from the chest up on the right, thoughtful, his left hand raised loosely to his chin so the red thread with its one knot shows on his wrist, on his left hand, on the right side of the picture; the upper left of the picture is empty dark night sky over the river. His face in the upper half on the right. No dog.
bk_43.setting: the riverbank in Butuan today at night: a low concrete embankment with a plain metal railing, the wide dark river, a few far lights on the other bank, black silhouettes of coconut palms; no signs, no writing anywhere
bk_43.light: night, deep blue darkness, a distant orange street lamp behind, the black river with long orange reflections, cool moonless sky, rim light, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork
bk_43.note: his face sits in the upper middle; the question text is left to the builder (no writing painted)
